title: Show it a picture or screenshot

steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
Things that are hard to explain in words are easy to show in a picture: receipts, tables, error messages on screen.

Today you'll learn three new things.

  1. Attach a picture to show Claude
  2. Turn what's in the picture into a table saved in a file
  3. How to take a screenshot of your own screen
  • Time: 15 minutes
  • You need: a computer that finished Desktop 6
Open this page on your computer for this practice. You'll download a sample picture to it.

steps.title: Download the sample receipt
steps.html:
Here's a receipt picture for practice. Click the button below to save it as receipt.webp in your computer's Downloads folder.

⬇ Download the sample receipt
steps.alt: A sample receipt from Earlln Mart

steps.title: If the download doesn't work
steps.html:
• You can also right-click the picture above (two-finger click on a Mac) → Save image as.
  • If you're viewing this on a phone, open this page on your computer.
  • Any other receipt or picture you have works too.

steps.title: Start with a new chat
steps.html:
1. Claude app → Code tab → + New.
  2. Check that the buttons under the typing box show Local · Practice · Manual.

check.q: Can you see Local · Practice · Manual?

steps.title: If the start screen looks different
steps.html:
• If the folder isn't Practice, click the folder button → Open folder… and choose it.
  • Click the permission mode button and choose Manual.

steps.title: Attach the picture to the typing box
steps.html:
1. Click the + button next to the typing box.
  2. Click Add files or photos.
  3. In the file window, go to Downloads → receipt.webp → Open.

If the picture shows up as a small tag in the typing box, it worked.

Another way: open the Downloads folder and drag receipt.webp onto the typing box.
steps.alt: Attaching a picture with + → Add files or photos

check.q: Is receipt.webp attached in the typing box?

steps.title: If the picture won't attach
steps.html:
• The + menu item may be named differently, like Add image. Choose the one for adding pictures or files.
  • Try dragging and dropping. It's easier with the Downloads window and Claude side by side.
  • In the file window, Downloads is in the list on the left.

steps.title: Ask it to read and organize the picture
steps.html: With the picture attached, type the sentence below and press {{enterkey}}. It's only reading the picture, so it won't ask permission.
steps.alt: Claude reads the receipt, makes a table and checks the total
steps.code: Look at this receipt and put the items and prices in a table. Also check whether the total is right

check.q: Did you get a table and a note checking the total?

steps.title: If it says it can't read the picture
steps.html:
• Check that you sent it with the picture attached; the tag should be in the typing box.
  • Blurry text can be misread. Try the sample picture first.

steps.title: Save the table to a file
steps.html: The table only lives in the chat. Let's keep it in a file. Read the create-file permission card and click Allow.

check.q: Is there a receipt-summary.txt in the Practice folder, with the table inside?

steps.title: If you don't see the file
steps.html:
• If you denied the card, send it again and allow it.
  • Check the folder under the typing box is Practice. It may have saved somewhere else.

steps.title: Be careful when you share pictures
steps.html:
• Double-check numbers: AI can misread text in pictures too. Compare important things like amounts and dates with the original. Adding "check whether the total is right", as today, helps.
  • Hide sensitive information: don't upload ID numbers, card numbers, passwords or other people's faces, or cover them first.
  • Make it clear: a straight, bright picture is read more accurately than a blurry or tilted one.

steps.title: How to take a screenshot
steps.html:
Use this when you want to show an error message or a table on your screen.

Windows⊞+Shift+S → drag to select the area → click the notification at the bottom right and Save (Ctrl+S)
Mac⌘+Shift+4 → drag to select the area → it's saved as a picture on your desktop

Attach the saved picture with + as you did today and ask things like "What does this error mean?" or "Turn this table into a spreadsheet layout."

steps.title: 🎉 Desktop practice 7 done! What you learned
steps.html:
Now you can hand over jobs by showing pictures instead of explaining in words.

Picture or screenshotattach with +Claude reads itorganizes and checksSaved to a file

Three things to remember

  1. Attach pictures with + → Add files or photos next to the typing box, or by dragging and dropping.
  2. AI can misread too. Check important numbers, and add "check whether it's right".
  3. Don't upload pictures with sensitive information, or cover it first.
